faqs.q: How do I assign a workout to a client?
faqs.a: Visit the Client's profile, select "Assign Workout", and choose from the exercise library.

faqs.q: How can I see client progress?
faqs.a: The Client dashboard provides a real-time view of their completed workouts and diet logs.

faqs.q: How do I manage session requests?
faqs.a: Check the "Sessions" tab to view, approve, or reschedule upcoming appointments with your clients.
